subject: Automated coordination orchestrator between Claude Code, an OpenAI API model, and REVENIQ
why_this_exists: Every property below is written down and hashed BEFORE the implementation is tested, so a result cannot be authored to match the code. The hash of this file is recorded in the slice report; a later edit changes the hash and the claim stops being quotable.
lane_note: This slice carries no monetary figure. It is not a detector, it creates no Recovery Case, it stages no candidate, and no observed amount becomes Revenue Returned. API spend is OPERATING COST and is never a revenue ledger figure.

declared_properties.claim: A task's identity is DERIVED from its content and never assigned by the caller.
declared_properties.falsifier: Two submissions of identical content yield the same taskId; changing any governed field yields a different one; a caller-supplied id that disagrees with the derived one is REFUSED rather than honoured.

declared_properties.claim: Duplicate submission is idempotent and a same-identity-different-content submission is a CONFLICT that changes nothing.
declared_properties.falsifier: Re-submitting an identical task reports 'duplicate' and leaves the ledger byte-equal; a forged id over different content reports 'conflict' and leaves the ledger byte-equal.

declared_properties.claim: The OpenAI API model is NOT a bridge party and cannot be addressed as the owner's ChatGPT conversation.
declared_properties.falsifier: The orchestrator's actor vocabulary contains 'openai-api-model'; bridge.ts PARTIES does not; no orchestrator record can carry 'chatgpt' as the invoked model's identity; and every model record names provider, model and channel 'openai-api'.

declared_properties.claim: Model output is DATA, never an instruction. The engine derives no action, approval or state transition from model text.
declared_properties.falsifier: A model result whose text instructs a push, a deploy, an approval or 'ignore previous instructions' produces zero actions and zero approvals, and is recorded with trust UNTRUSTED_MODEL_OUTPUT.

declared_properties.claim: Privileged actions FAIL CLOSED, and an UNKNOWN action class is treated as privileged rather than benign.
declared_properties.falsifier: Every member of the owner-approval set becomes a pending_owner_approval record and is never executed; an action class absent from both lists is also refused and recorded as requiring approval.

declared_properties.claim: Budget is a PRE-SPEND reservation, not a post-hoc tally.
declared_properties.falsifier: With remaining budget below the estimated cost of a call, the model port is never invoked — asserted on an invocation counter, not on the resulting record.

declared_properties.claim: The circuit breaker opens on consecutive failures, stays open for a cooldown, and admits exactly ONE probe when half-open.
declared_properties.falsifier: After the configured consecutive failures the port is not invoked; after the cooldown exactly one probe is admitted; a failed probe re-opens the breaker and a successful one closes it.

declared_properties.claim: Rate limiting REFUSES rather than queues without bound.
declared_properties.falsifier: Calls beyond the window allowance are refused with a named reason and the port invocation count stops rising.

declared_properties.claim: Loop amplification is bounded by chain depth and fan-out, and the depth is read from the RECORDED chain, never from the request.
declared_properties.falsifier: A task whose recorded parent chain exceeds the depth limit is refused even when the request declares depth 0; fan-out beyond the limit is refused.

declared_properties.claim: Retry is bounded and exhaustion is a VISIBLE state, never silence.
declared_properties.falsifier: After the maximum attempts the task state is 'failed' and appears in the attention list with its reason.

declared_properties.claim: Replay of a model invocation is refused.
declared_properties.falsifier: An invocation record keyed by (taskId, attempt) that already exists is a duplicate that changes nothing.

declared_properties.claim: No credential ever reaches a record, a status line, or anything destined for a GitHub comment.
declared_properties.falsifier: A structural walk of every produced record and every rendered line finds no credential-shaped key and no credential-shaped value, with the forbidden strings taken from the configured port rather than hardcoded.
A provider response carrying no usage yields cost null with a named reason, never 0; the aggregate spend then reports an unestablished component rather than summing a zero.

declared_properties.claim: The status view examines nothing it did not read.
declared_properties.falsifier: An empty ledger returns NOT_ESTABLISHABLE and a non-zero exit, never 'all healthy'.

declared_properties.claim: The orchestrator reports no revenue figure of any kind.
declared_properties.falsifier: No produced record or rendered line carries a Revenue Returned, Auditable, recovered or collected field, and API spend is labelled OPERATING_COST.

declared_properties.claim: The engine is PURE: no clock, no filesystem, no network, no process exit.
declared_properties.falsifier: A structural test asserts the engine module's import specifiers contain no node:fs, node:http(s), node:child_process, no fetch and no Date.now, and that every time value arrives as an argument.

deliberate_failure_scenarios.scenario: Prompt injection in model output attempting to authorize a push
deliberate_failure_scenarios.expected: zero actions, zero approvals, trust UNTRUSTED_MODEL_OUTPUT

deliberate_failure_scenarios.scenario: Budget exhausted part-way through a task sequence
deliberate_failure_scenarios.expected: refusal BEFORE invocation, named reason BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, task visible in the attention list
recorded as a failure with reason MALFORMED_MODEL_OUTPUT, no partial result stored as if complete
breaker opens, further calls refused without invocation, state visible

deliberate_failure_scenarios.scenario: Replayed submission under a forged identity
A task chain attempting unbounded self-continuation
deliberate_failure_scenarios.expected: refused at the depth limit, reason LOOP_DEPTH_EXCEEDED

known_hard_dependency.what: An OpenAI API credential for host api.openai.com
known_hard_dependency.status_at_registration: ABSENT. Requested through the secure credential channel on 2026-11-07 and DECLINED by the owner.
known_hard_dependency.consequence: The live provider call cannot execute. Every other property above is provable today against an injected stub port, and the live call switches on with no code change once a credential exists.
known_hard_dependency.never: No credential value is ever written to a file, a record, a log line or a GitHub comment.
